e.title: actudist (Python)
e.summary: 精算损失分布 Python 包（Klugman Loss Models 参数化）：每个严重度分布暴露 LEV/超额纯保费/ILF 分层统计
e.body: actudist 是精算损失分布 Python 包（PyPI，MIT，Python 3.10+）：遵循 Klugman《Loss Models》的参数化约定——每个严重度分布都暴露分层统计（LEV 损失期望值、超额纯保费、ILF 损失递增因子）作为方法，MLE 支持右删失与单/双侧截断样本。对 RIAA：损失建模（severity）的 Python 侧实用库——LEV/ILF 正是再保险定价与止损分析需要的量。与 [[pareto-r]]、[[comppareto]]、[[logngpd]]（拼接分布）、[[insurance-severity]]（burning-cost 严重度）互补。关联 [[actuar-r]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README + PyPI 核实：Klugman Loss Models 参数化，LEV/超额纯保费/ILF 方法，截断删失 MLE，MIT
e.summary_en: Python actuarial loss-distribution package (Klugman Loss Models parameterizations): every severity distribution exposes LEV/excess pure premium/ILF layer statistics
e.summary_hk: 精算損失分佈 Python 包（Klugman Loss Models 參數化）：每個嚴重度分佈暴露 LEV/超額純保費/ILF 分層統計
e.body_en: actudist is a Python actuarial loss-distribution package (PyPI, MIT, Python 3.10+): it follows the parameterizations of Klugman's 'Loss Models' — every severity distribution exposes layer statistics (LEV, excess pure premium, ILF) as methods, and MLE accepts right-censored and one-/two-sided truncated samples. For RIAA: the Python-side utility library for loss (severity) modelling — LEV/ILF are exactly the quantities needed for reinsurance pricing and stop-loss analysis. Complements [[pareto-r]], [[comppareto]], [[logngpd]] (spliced distributions) and [[insurance-severity]] (burning-cost severity). Related: [[actuar-r]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]].
e.body_hk: actudist 是精算損失分佈 Python 包（PyPI，MIT，Python 3.10+）：遵循 Klugman《Loss Models》的參數化約定——每個嚴重度分佈都暴露分層統計（LEV 損失期望值、超額純保費、ILF 損失遞增因子）作為方法，MLE 支持右刪失與單/雙側截斷樣本。對 RIAA：損失建模（severity）的 Python 側實用庫——LEV/ILF 正是再保險定價與止損分析需要的量。與 [[pareto-r]]、[[comppareto]]、[[logngpd]]（拼接分佈）、[[insurance-severity]]（burning-cost 嚴重度）互補。關聯 [[actuar-r]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。
